list.text: Heh… These pink Pokémon look weak...
Heh… These pink Pokémon look weak. Easy targets.
Then you show up and ruin my day.\nLet’s settle this!
\f[facejenny]\rWelcome to Pinkan Island.\nAs you may know, this is a protected Pokémon reserve.
\f[facejenny]\rThat means you can’t catch any Pokémon on this island.
\f[facejenny]\rBut we’ve had a problem lately... \nThese Pink Pokémon are rare, and rare Pokémon attract the wrong kind of attention.
\f[facejenny]\rI’ve spotted a few suspicious people sneaking around the island, but keeping watch alone is tough.

branches.text: \f[facejenny]\rThere should be at least three suspects hiding somewhere on this island.
\f[facejenny]\rWould be great if you help me find the and drive them off.

list.text: \f[facejenny]\rWelcome to Pinkan Island.\nAs you may know, this is a protected Pokémon reserve.
\f[facejenny]\rThat means you can’t catch any Pokémon on this island.
\f[facejenny]\rBut we’ve had a problem lately...\n These Pink Pokémon are rare, and rare Pokémon attract the wrong kind of attention.
\f[facejenny]\rI’ve spotted a few suspicious people sneaking around the island, but keeping watch alone is tough.
\f[facejenny]\rThere should be at least three suspects hiding somewhere on this island.
\f[facejenny]\rWould be great if you help me find the and drive them off.
\f[facejenny]\rYou’re back!\nAnd from the look on your face… you found them, didn’t you?
\f[facejenny]\rI knew I could count on you! \nThat should keep the pink Pokémon safe for a while.
\f[facejenny]\rWhoa! A Pink Rhyhorn?! It must be stressed from all the burglars earlier!
\f[facejenny]\rCareful! It looks like it wants to battle!

list.ruby:
setBattleRule("cannotRun")
setBattleRule("canLose")
pkmn = Pokemon.new(:RHYHORN_1, 55)
pkmn.learn_move(:EARTHQUAKE)
pkmn.learn_move(:DIG)
pkmn.learn_move(:MEGAHORN)
pkmn.learn_move(:LIGHTSCREEN)
WildBattle.start(pkmn)

list.text: \f[facejenny]\rYou handled that amazingly!\nThat Rhyhorn must’ve been on edge from all the trouble today.

then.text: \f[facejenny]\rIt’ll calm down and return to the wild.
\f[facejenny]\rIt’ll calm down and return to the wild.
\f[facejenny]\rTaking care of it is the best thing you could’ve done.
\f[facejenny]\rNormally, catching Pokémon here is strictly forbidden.
\f[facejenny]\rBut after everything you did to help today...\nI’m willing to make an exception.
\f[facejenny]\rI can tell you’re a Trainer who treats Pokémon with respect.
\f[facejenny]\rConsider it a special permit, granted only to you.
\f[facejenny]\rTake good care of that Pinkan Rhyhorn. It’s one of a kind.

else.text: \f[facejenny]\rThank you, truly.\nWith your help, Pinkan Island is safe again.

list.text: \f[facejenny]\rWelcome to Pinkan Island.\nAs you may know, this is a protected Pokémon reserve.
\f[facejenny]\rThat means you can’t catch any Pokémon on this island.
Pinkan Island\nWhere pink Pokémon live in peace!
Tch! Who told you about me?! I’m just… sightseeing!
Tch! Who told you about me?! I’m just… sightseeing!
Okay fine, I’m here for the pink Pokémon! \nThey’d sell for a fortune!
But if you think you can stop me, you’re wrong!

then.text: Fine, fine! I’m leaving!\nThis place isn’t worth the trouble…

list.text: Huh?! You found me?! I picked the perfect hiding spot!
Huh?! You found me?! I picked the perfect hiding spot!
These pink Pokémon are my big break!\nI’m not letting you ruin this!
